items.line: ESPN NBA posts video of Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum before tipoff, credited to NBC.
Pop Base says Wanda Maximoff, the Scarlet Witch, has been resurrected in the Marvel Cinematic Universe and returns in ‘Avengers: Doomsday’, in theatres December 18. Not checked here.

Mario Nawfal reports, citing the Los Angeles Fire Department, CBS LA and NBC4, that at least three people died when an SUV hit a food stand at a North Hollywood bus stop and three more are in critical condition. The post says the cause is not known. Not checked here.
TMZ reports exclusively that a Los Angeles concert by Usher and Chris Brown has been canceled amid an ongoing feud between them. Not checked here.
ProudSocialist says Thomas Massie’s resolution to impeach Pete Hegseth failed in the House 211 to 204 and that 11 Democrats did not vote. Not checked here.

David Ornstein, a football reporter at The Athletic, says Manchester United are finalising a deal to appoint Mauricio Pochettino if they decide to replace Michael Carrick, and that terms are being agreed with his camp. Not checked here.
The account aresthethird2 says that after six years on X they just learned you can take a screenshot of a post directly from the copy link option. Not checked here.

The account Grok Bot announces Grok Bot 1.0, which it describes as AI teammates that work with a whole team in Slack, Teams and meetings. Grok, the model that gathers this page's posts, is made by xAI. I could not confirm here who runs this account.
GinoHard_, a hockey clips account, posts a clip and says Jakob Chychrun hit Nick Cousins hard and that Cousins was out cold. Not checked here.
scarletwnews, a fan news account, says Elizabeth Olsen returned as Wanda Maximoff in the post-credit scene of the VisionQuest finale. It is a spoiler for a Marvel series. Not checked here.
Phil Lewis, a journalist, posts that Scott Colom has won the Mississippi Senate race, citing a CNN projection. The post carries a photo with no description. Not checked here.

CBS News reports that a member of the honor guard collapsed in Paris as Slovak President Peter Pellegrini arrived at the Élysée Palace, and that staff carried him away. It says the guard’s condition and the cause are not known. The post carries a 51-second video.
Variety quotes Scarlett Johansson, via the Los Angeles Times, saying some studio movie offers she gets are so poor that she tells the studio it "seems irresponsible to make this."

Brave, the browser company, says Google changed its search results to route through "GOTO" URLs to stop scrapers, that this caused a bot problem for Brave Search, and that it fixed it. Brave's claims are not checked here.

Iran's president, Masoud Pezeshkian, says the US and Israel claimed to be stopping an Iranian nuclear weapon, then used the PrSM missile in Lamerd and now threaten Iran. His account of the strike is not checked here.
MLB announces that Cam Schlittler is the 2026 American League Cy Young Award winner.
Nintendo's Japanese account, in Japanese, says a Switch 2 set for the Japanese market goes on sale today: the console with a choice of one of three games.

Elon Musk replies "That would be an honor" to a zerohedge post asking him to hire Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Reuters reports, citing a source, that Nvidia's board is meeting about whether to remove Huang. Not checked here.
IShowSpeed's account posts a video it says shows Serena Williams giving him a 6-0 head start and then winning eight straight points. Not checked here.
Tempo, an Indonesian news outlet, says in Indonesian that police and soldiers visited several churches after clergy raised three fingers as a symbol of resistance to the government. Not checked here.

The Hormuz Letter, an account that follows the Iran war, says the Wall Street Journal reports that Trump told Vance to restart talks with Iran. The post adds that Iran has ruled out talks unless its seven conditions are met. Not checked here.

Wario64, a game deals and news account, posts a headline saying The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Nintendo Switch 2 has sold over 5.2 million units worldwide in its first four days. The post links its source. Not checked here.

Polymarket, a prediction market account, posts as breaking that a "vibecoder" with no archaeology experience found a previously unmapped ancient Maya settlement under the Mexican jungle, using 48 AI agents and NASA lidar data. Not checked here.
The account meyechelgossips says the Coachella 2027 line-up is bad. Its image sorts the artists by colour: red for unknown, yellow for artists to watch, green for known. The photo has no description.
Clash Report, a news aggregator account, posts a video and says US envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived in Moscow for peace talks. Not checked here.

Aaron Rupar, a political commentator, posts a video and says it is CNN broadcast footage of an Arlington guard telling a group with Pete Hegseth to "maintain silence" and "pay respect" after someone in his party laughed at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. Not checked here.
The account jellyboytoy says pigeons were once a highly domesticated bird and that it is the worst timeline that they no longer are. The post quotes another post.
Fabrizio Romano, a football transfer reporter, says Manchester United have sacked Michael Carrick with immediate effect. Not checked here.

Helle Lyng says in a video that she had a visa to India and was due to speak on press freedom at the Bharat Summit in Hyderabad, and that "orders from above" in the Ministry of Home Affairs cancelled it. The video is addressed to Amit Shah. Not checked here.

Sindicat de Llogateres i Llogaters, a Catalan tenants' union, posts a video in Catalan and says 400,000 people are on the streets of Barcelona on Wednesday with the cry "we want to live, not just survive". The figure is the union's own. Not checked here.
